title: ContentWorkspaceSubscription - Data API
description: Represents a subscription for a user following a library. This object is available in API version 42.0 and later.

ContentWorkspaceId.description: ID of the library. This is a relationship field.

UserId.description: ID of the user following the library. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules:
Only users with Modify All Data permission have access to this object.
